title: Applicative & Monad with Maybe
hints: README 'New syntax': `<$>`/`<*>` for addMaybes, a Maybe `do` block or `>>=` for the chains, a list `do` block for pairsUpTo.

addMaybes: fmap (+) over a, then apply to b. emailForUser: get the name with `<-`, then look up its email. rootOfRecip: safeRecip first, feed its result to safeRoot. pairsUpTo: x from 1..n, y from x..n, pure the pair.
Other data: `max <$> Just 3 <*> Just 9` → Just 9 · `quarter n = halfEven n >>= halfEven` · `do { a <- [1, 2]; b <- "xy"; pure (a, b) }`.
`addMaybes a b = (+) <$> a <*> b` · `rootOfRecip x = safeRecip x >>= safeRoot` · `pairsUpTo n = do { x <- [1 .. n]; y <- [x .. n]; pure (x, y) }`.
